title: Question
content: Does anyone else get effectively punished for talking about mallworld? For example. For the past week after posting a bunch of stuff about it, I have not been allowed at mallworld and have to deal with bullcrap normie dreams that have to involve the day to day grind irl or awaken not allowed to remember anything. Also I have zero lucid abilities to be able to alter my dreams and cannot transport or change locations. This happens so often after talking about my dreams thats it has to be beyond coincidence now.
